# ojothemes

This package contains OK Policy branded themes for
[ggplot2](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org) plots and
[gt](https://gt.rstudio.com) tables. There are currently three different
looks available:

- `"okpi"` is our default OK Policy branding,
- `"ojo"` is for the defunct Open Justice Oklahoma branding, and
- `"tok"` is for the Together Oklahoma theme.

## {ggplot2}
